content.text: – pancreatic β cells fail to respond to stimuli & undergo autoimmune destruction
– others: d/c/inadeq insulin tx, undx DM, MI, CVA, pancreatitis
polydipsia, polyuria, & wt loss + hyperglycemia & ketonemia (or kentonuria)
Child appears acutely ill & suffers from mod to profound dehydration
: norm glucose until 2-8am when it rises; results from ↓ insulin sensitivity & a nightly surge of counter-regulatory hormones during nighttime fasting
: bedtime inj of NPH to blunt Am hyperglycemia; ⍉carbs late @ night
: nocturnal hypoglycemia followed by rebound hyperglycemia d/t surge in GH
: ↓ nighttime NPH dose or give bedtime snack
: a progress rise in glucose from bed to Am
: Δ of insulin dose to bedtime
Random plasma glucose ≥200mg/dL + classic s/sxs of hyperglycemia
, but serum K = norm/↑(K shift from ICF to ECF)
: long-acting insulin injections 1-2x/d + rapid or short-acting insulin b4 each meal/snack
: delivers cont SC infusion of rapid or short-acting insulin + supplemented boluses b4 each meal/snack
SIPS – saline, insulin (regular), potassium repletion, search for underlying cause
once serum glucose reaches ~200-250, add dextrose
*if serum glucose doesn’t fall by ± 50-70mg/dL in the first hr, DOUBLE rate of insulin infusion
regardless of serum K, pts have a lrg total body K deficit
give IV KCl 20-40mEq/L until K above 3.3mEq/L
check serum K q2h & delay KCl admin until serum K <5.3mEq/L
ONLY GIVEN TO PTS W/ pH <6.90
(admin assoc w/ comp of overcorrection & ↑cerebral edema)
: seen in older pts, assoc w/ more severe dehydration;
: tachy, hypotension, ↓ skin turgor, ↑ cap refill time
▪︎acanthosis nigricans (velvety hyperpigmentation = insulin resistance); DM = RF for carpal tunnel syndrome
Random plasma glucose ≥200mg/dL + classic s/sxs of hyperglycemia
▪︎>75yo + life expectancy ≥2.5y → moderate-intensity after risk/benefit discussion
▪︎20-39yo + long-duration DM, albuminuria, eGFR <60, retinopathy, neuropathy, or ABI <0.9 → moderate-intensity
▪︎CAD in DM: PCI acceptable in single-vessel dz; DM + multivessel dz → CABG preferred
